note: The status checks the branch ruleset makes a merge condition. Every entry is reported by a job in a workflow that triggers on pull_request with no trigger filter, so it reports on EVERY pull request — a check that never reports blocks the merge forever. scripts/check-merge-gates.mjs enforces that from the workflow side; `pnpm check:gates --ruleset` diffs this list against the live ruleset, which no token in CI is allowed to read. Third-party contexts (codecov/*) are deliberately absent: they report only when an upload happens.
integration_id_note: GitHub Actions' app id. A ruleset entry matches on the app as well as the context name, so an entry pinned to another app is satisfied by nothing these workflows can report, and one pinned to no app is satisfied by anything that reports the name.
